candidate.scope: V1 observational hooks plus corrected source-encoded MOL/isotope identity fields; no radiation or line-processing behavior changes.

identity: external run receipt's exact TAPE3 SHA-256
selection.decision_join: LNCOR1 invocation ordinal is stored for each active buffer slot and repeated in CNVFNV rows; the source-encoded MOL and original IFLAG are retained before LNCOR1 reduces MOL to molecule number.

reason_codes.RDLIN_2: panel header VMAX<VBOT; data block skipped by existing RDLIN gate
reason_codes.RDLIN_3: main row lies below VBOT while RDLIN selects ILO
reason_codes.RDLIN_4: main row lies after the active IHI range and is deferred by the current RDLIN selection
reason_codes.LNCOR1_3: isotope exceeds the configured isotope maximum
reason_codes.LNCOR1_7: IFLAG=0 rejected by SPEAK<=DPTMN+DPTFC*R4(JJ) with zero SPP/SP
reason_codes.LNCOR1_8: IFLAG=0 rejected by previously read FREJ state
reason_codes.LNCOR1_9: SP/SPPSP corrected strength was computed; subsequent SPEAK/FREJ filters have not necessarily passed. A phase-3 CNVFNV event proves entry to CNVFNV.
reason_codes.CNVFNV_10: SP equals zero at CNVFNV entry
reason_codes.CNVFNV_11: JMAX1>MAX1; this call hands the line to later panel processing before writes
reason_codes.CNVFNV_12: computed J3 stencil overlaps target R3 indices 61-64
reason_codes.CNVFNV_13: computed J3 stencil does not overlap target R3 indices 61-64

fields: phase/reason, layer, pass/block/slot identity, LNCOR1 batch ordinal, outer IOUT index, buffer slot, original IFLAG/MOL/isotope
KPANEL/IPANEL/IDATA, ILO/IHI, MAX1, JMIN1/JMAX1/J3SHFT, target overlap bounds
VNU, VFT, VBOT/VTOP, support operand, SUI, SP, SPPSP, ALFL, ALFV, RECALF and two branch-specific auxiliary scalars
event_schema.unknown_numeric_sentinel: Negative HUGE of the declared real kind marks values not yet computed or not used by that decision; it is not a physical value.

source_behavior_preserved.control_flow: Original one-line zero-SUI, support, and FREJ jumps are wrapped in equivalent IF/THEN blocks; each still executes the same label-25 jump after the observational hook. No condition operand or evaluation order is changed. Diagnostic identity now mirrors the pinned source ISO decoding; no source isotope or IFLAG value is rewritten.

remaining_limits: The patch needs independent static review and a fresh diagnostic build before any future run; neither is included here.
The RDLIN block identity is an ordinal within a rewind pass and is only stable when joined to the exact external TAPE3 hash and candidate source/build pins.

Block headers rejected by VMAX<VBOT have no per-line buffer slots because RDLIN deliberately does not load their data record; the ledger records the block ordinal, VMAX and gate operands, not each un-read line identity.
This ledger can show candidate routing and source-declared decisions, not whether a physical cancellation partner ought to exist or whether negative optical depth is physically valid.

static_checks.compiler_or_parser_validation: Not performed; no Fortran compile/parser was invoked.
static_checks.diff_check: No whitespace errors; --no-index returned the expected differences status 1 with empty diagnostics.

identity_correction.encoded_mol_field: Pass udm37_rdlin_id(4,I) unchanged in RDLIN reason 1 and retain the same encoded value in other diagnostic events.
identity_correction.source_reference: Pinned base LNCOR1 computes ISO = MOD(MOL(I),I_1000)/100 at build/udm37-lblrtm-r3-term-trace-v1/source/LBLRTM/src/oprop.f90:1016.
identity_correction.source_identity_preserved: The original IFLAG and encoded MOL are copied from the RDLIN identity buffer; only the diagnostic isotope derivation is computed. This mirrors source encoding and avoids replacing encoded MOL with a reduced molecule-only value.
identity_correction.v1_issue: The nested MOD(MOD(encoded_MOL,1000),100)/100 expression returned zero for every encoded integer; the RDLIN reason-1 MOL field also reduced the encoded value with MOD(...,100).
identity_correction.applied_to: All seven diagnostic isotope expressions in RDLIN/LNCOR1/CNVFNV event records; source LNCOR1 expression itself is unmodified.

stage_semantics_correction.reason: LNCOR1 reason 9 is emitted immediately after SPPSP calculation and before downstream SPEAK/FREJ filtering.
stage_semantics_correction.correct_interpretation: Reason 9 records computed corrected strength and progress to the next source location only. Do not describe it as having survived all LNCOR1 filters or as CNVFNV acceptance.
stage_semantics_correction.entry_evidence: A phase-3 CNVFNV event for the same LNCOR invocation ordinal is the diagnostic evidence that CNVFNV was reached.
